notes.title: Hazard Pay on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hazard Pay has been tested extensively on the Steam Deck and is the perfect form-factor for destroying evidence on the go.

Please report any issues via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2692620/discussions/0/595141609677441324/]Steam Discussion[/url] or on the [url=https://smitner.studio/discord]Discord[/url]
